## The Hope Diamond’s Two-Day Journey by Mail

In November 1958, jeweler Harry Winston donated the 45.5-carat Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian. The gem made the trip from New York by registered first-class mail, packed in a plain brown package.

It was sent from New York’s General Post Office on November 8. The postage cost $2.44, and registration cost $142.85. The diamond arrived at the Smithsonian on November 10 and was presented at a ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.
